$comment: Traceability: ack for worker.events.append. The service assigns the host-local monotonic seq (the client replay cursor) and stamps server time; duplicate event_ids report duplicate:true instead of double-storing.

server_time_ms.description: Service clock, UTC millis. The only clock that matters; worker-supplied times are never authoritative.

duplicate.description: True when this event_id was already stored: the retry was absorbed, nothing was double-appended.

seq.description: Host-local monotonic sequence: the replay cursor clients use.

title: service.events.stored
